description: Bitcoin: Get the newest confirmed transactions for an address, up to `max_txs` (25 by default and at most). For pagination, request `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain/{after_txid}` with the last returned txid.

address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

max_txs.description: Transactions to return, at most 25 (the default); larger values return 25.

name: get_address_confirmed_txs
title: Address confirmed transactions
